history.note: Approved by the owner in chat on 2026-11-17 (You merge and approve). Recorded on the owner's behalf by claude-code-dartonx-pc, which also fast-forwarded game main to cddd03b. No pull request was opened.

result.summary: Scaffold compiles on UE 5.8.4 (ETMEditor Win64 Development, zero errors and warnings). Toolchain locked in the game repo's docs/TOOLCHAIN.md. XR path is the engine's OpenXR + XRBase plugins, no Meta XR plugin, so nothing depends on Horizon OS features after v2.13 (P-15). Fixes: XRBase module and plugin added, EngineAssociation 5.8, r.DefaultFeature.AntiAliasing replaced by r.AntiAliasingMethod, Quest packaging keys added, invalid ProjectID replaced.
result.verification: Built ETMEditor Win64 Development with UnrealBuildTool; loaded the project in a headless editor commandlet with 0 errors. No interactive editor session, no Android package, no device test.
result.remaining: Android target is not installed in this engine, so packaging is untried. JDK 21 and SDK levels 32/32 come from Epic's template and are unverified. 72 Hz must be set and confirmed on device. Branch agent/claude-code-dartonx-pc/t-0005 is local until pushed.
result.next: Owner or another agent reviews T-0005. Then T-0006 (needs the engine's Android target and Quest 2 Developer Mode), T-0007 and T-0011 can start.
